fields.mechanism: The paper's title and context imply that during cold start conditions, the ion current profile in the first combustion cycle deviates significantly due to poor mixture preparation, leading to misfire events characterized by weak or absent ionization charge in the initial spark cycles.
fields.intervention: Implement a cold-temperature compensation strategy in the ignition system ECU that increases spark duration and advances spark timing specifically for sub-zero ambient temperatures to ensure reliable first-cycle ignition in the Toyota Corolla 2019.
fields.expected_effect: The increased ionization charge during the first cycle after cold start will prevent misfire and stall at idle when temperatures drop below zero.
fields.falsification_test: Install a modified ion current sensor on a 2019 Toyota Corolla, drive the vehicle into a cold environment below zero, and measure the ion current trace during idle; if the misfire persists while the ion current trace shows sufficient charge at standard ignition settings, the hypothesis that it is a misfire caused by weak first-cycle combustion is false.
fields.mechanism_source_span: Misfire and Additional Spark Ignition at First Combustion Cycle

fields.mechanism: The paper investigates the correlation between misfire events and the quality of ignition (spark energy and initial flame kernel growth) during the first combustion cycle in cold conditions, using modified tandem ion current detection to characterize the physical process of combustion instability.
fields.intervention: Implement a diagnostic strategy that monitors ion current signals specifically during the first combustion cycle after cold start to distinguish between insufficient spark energy, delayed auto-ignition, and fuel mixture stratification, thereby isolating the root cause of the cold-temperature misfire.
fields.expected_effect: The method allows for the precise identification of whether the misfire is due to weak spark, poor mixture, or chemical kinetics (auto-ignition delay) specific to cold conditions, enabling targeted calibration of the ignition system or fuel strategy for sub-zero temperatures.
fields.falsification_test: Install the modified tandem ion current detection system on the 2019 Toyota Corolla; if the ion current trace shows a normal burn rate despite the misfire, the mechanism is not combustion instability but rather a physical failure (e.g., injector clog or sensor error), falsifying the hypothesis that the misfire is due to the specific cold-start ignition dynamics described in the paper.

fields.mechanism: Tandem ion current detection enabling additional spark ignition during the first combustion cycle to prevent misfire
fields.intervention: Install a modified form tandem ion current detection system on the 2019 Toyota Corolla ignition circuit to trigger an additional spark when ion current indicates incomplete combustion below zero degrees Celsius
fields.expected_effect: The additional spark ignites residual mixture during cold idle, eliminating the misfire and stall condition exclusively present at sub-zero temperatures
fields.falsification_test: Operate the vehicle at minus five degrees Celsius with the tandem ion current detection system active; if the engine still misfires or stalls at idle while the system registers ion current and commands an additional spark, the mechanism is falsified
